_note: Hotel stays (src/app/hotels, src/app/hotel/[stayId]): luxury suites only, at any hotel on the map. Every suite has the king bed, an in-suite jacuzzi on the terrace, a spa room (massage table and steam room), a gaming lounge, a minibar and room service. Prices per night (AED) and room-service prices are mirrored exactly in public.hotel_suite_rule() and public.hotel_service_price() (*_hotels.sql; checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs).
